تبتعثين (form VIII)
# تَبْتَعِثِينَ (tabtaʕiṯīna) /tab.ta.ʕi.θiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
# تُبْتَعَثِينَ (tubtaʕaṯīna) /tub.ta.ʕa.θiː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اِبْتَعَثَ (ibtaʕaṯa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
